headline: Councils gain power to block new vape and betting shops
standfirst: Local leaders are getting more control over the high street to fix town centre decline.

steps.label: What happened
steps.text: The Prime Minister announced new powers for councils to restrict vape and betting shops.

steps.label: How we got here
steps.text: Decades of decline have left many town centres feeling hollowed out and empty.

steps.label: Why it matters
steps.text: This aims to give local authorities control over what kind of businesses open in their areas.

steps.label: What to watch
steps.text: Keep an eye on how local councils use these new powers to reshape their high streets.

caption:
Prime Minister Andy Burnham has announced that councils will get new powers to stop vape and betting shops.

Town centres have faced years of decline, leading to a hollowing out of local high streets. This move aims to give communities more say over the types of businesses allowed to open in their areas.

Do you think your local high street needs more variety or are these restrictions too much?
